content.title: About
content.content: Trail mix with chocolate is a blend of dried fruits, nuts, and pieces of dark or milk chocolate. This mix combines crunchy nuts, sweet dried fruit, and aromatic chocolate, providing a quick source of energy and a pleasant taste.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Trail mixes were originally used by climbers and hikers as a lightweight, nutritious snack on the trail.
Chocolate in the mix is often coated with nuts, which reduces sugar crystallization and extends shelf life.
The combination of nuts and dried fruit delivers a wide range of vitamins and minerals, including potassium, magnesium, and vitamin E.
In many countries trail mixes are sold in single‑serve packets, convenient for gyms and offices.

items.title: Energy support
items.content: Carbohydrates from dried fruit and healthy fats from nuts quickly replenish glycogen stores and sustain endurance.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Chocolate, especially dark, provides flavonoids, while nuts supply vitamin E, helping protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Cardiovascular support
items.content: Monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fats in nuts help lower LDL cholesterol levels.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: Both dried fruit and nuts are high in fiber, promoting healthy digestion.

items.title: Muscle‑supporting minerals
items.content: Magnesium and potassium found in nuts and dried fruit aid muscle function and nerve signaling.

items.title: Tree‑nut allergy
items.content: The mix may contain peanuts, almonds, cashews, or other nuts that can trigger allergic reactions.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Dried fruits and chocolate add significant sugar, which may be problematic for diabetics or those watching sugar intake.

items.title: Calorie density
items.content: Trail mix is calorie‑dense; portion control is advisable, especially on weight‑management diets.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Some versions include salted nuts; people monitoring sodium should choose unsalted options.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Trail mix with chocolate is convenient as a standalone snack, or can be added to yogurt, oatmeal, or smoothies. It also works well in baked goods such as granola bars or as a topping for desserts.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place away from direct light. For longer storage keep it in the refrigerator to prevent nut oils from going rancid and chocolate from melting.
